translations.literal: For going against the imperial intent he was sent out as prefect of Xuan Prefecture, changed to palace attendant censor, and promoted to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Having offended the throne's intent, he was posted to Xuan Prefecture, then made palace attendant censor and promoted to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 頻雅善丁謂，謂貶，左遷尚書比部員外郎、監饒州酒。

translations.literal: Pin had long been friendly with Ding Wei; when Wei was demoted Pin was transferred to yuanwailang in the Ministry of Justice comparison bureau and supervisor of Raozhou wine.
translations.idiomatic: Pin had long been close to Ding Wei; when Wei fell, Pin was demoted to yuanwailang in the Ministry of Justice and put in charge of Raozhou wine.

sentences.zh: 起知信州，進刑部員外郎、知福州。

translations.literal: He was recalled as prefect of Xin Prefecture, advanced to yuanwailang in the Ministry of Justice and prefect of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as prefect of Xin Prefecture and advanced to yuanwailang in the Ministry of Justice and prefect of Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 王氏時，賦民官田，歲輸租稅而已。

translations.literal: In the Wang Shu era the people paid rent tax on official fields—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wang Shu regime the people paid annual rent on official fields and nothing more.

sentences.zh: 至是，或謂鬻之可得緡錢二十餘萬，頻疏以為不可。

translations.literal: By this time some said selling them could yield more than two hundred thousand strings of cash; Pin memorialized that this could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Now some argued the fields could be sold for more than two hundred thousand strings of cash; Pin memorialized that this must not be done.

sentences.zh: 徙知潭州。

translations.literal: He was moved to prefect of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改廣西轉運使，擿宜州守貪暴不法，既罷去，反訟頻子許嘗被刑，而冒奏為秘書省校書郎，頻坐謫知饒州。

translations.literal: Changed to transport commissioner for Guangxi; he exposed the prefect of Yi Prefecture for greedy and lawless conduct; after the prefect was removed he sued back claiming Pin's son Xu had once been punished and falsely reported as collator in the Secretariat—Pin was demoted to prefect of Raozhou on this charge.
translations.idiomatic: Made transport commissioner for Guangxi, he impeached the prefect of Yi for greed and lawlessness; after the prefect's removal he counter-sued, claiming Pin's son Xu had once been flogged yet was falsely entered as a Secretariat collator—Pin was demoted to prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 復入為度支判官，累遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He re-entered as judge of the Revenue Section, and was promoted in succession to director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He returned as Revenue Section judge and rose in succession to director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 使契丹，至紫濛館卒。

translations.literal: On embassy to the Khitan he died at the Zimeng lodge.
translations.idiomatic: While on embassy to the Khitan he died at the Zimeng lodge.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣內侍就館奠祭，命接伴副使吳克荷護其喪，以錦車駕橐駝載至中京，斂以銀飾棺，又具鼓吹羽葆，吏士持甲兵衛送至白溝。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent a eunuch to the lodge to offer sacrifices, ordered the deputy reception commissioner Wu Kehe to escort the funeral, loaded the coffin on a brocade cart drawn by camels to the central capital, placed it in a silver-decorated coffin, also provided music and feather banners, with officials and soldiers in armor escorting to the Bai Gou border.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sent a palace eunuch to mourn at the lodge, had deputy reception commissioner Wu Kehe escort the funeral, carried the coffin on a brocade cart with camels to the central capital, fitted a silver-trimmed coffin, supplied music and feather banners, and sent armored escorts to the Bai Gou border.

sentences.zh: 詔遣其子訪乘傳扈其柩以歸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his son Fang to travel by express post to escort the coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered his son Fang to ride the express relay and escort the coffin home.

sentences.zh: 訪，官三班奉職，即許也。

translations.literal: Fang held the post of duty officer in the Three-Rank Court—that is, Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was a duty officer in the Three-Rank Court—that is, Xu.

sentences.zh: 陳琰，字伯玉，澶州臨河人。

translations.literal: Chen Yan, styled Boyu, was a native of Linhe in Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yan, styled Boyu, was from Linhe in Chan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，歷溧陽、欒城縣主簿，遷大理寺丞、監真定府稅，知金堂、夏津二縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi and served in succession as recorder of Liyang and Luancheng counties, promoted to vice director in the Court of Judicial Review and supervisor of Zhending tax, and governed Jintang and Xiajin counties.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi, he served as recorder of Liyang and Luancheng, became vice director in the Court of Judicial Review and supervisor of Zhending tax, and governed Jintang and Xiajin counties.

sentences.zh: 再遷太常博士。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 轉運使盧士倫，曹利用婿也，怙勢聽獄不以直，訟者不已，付琰評決，琰直之。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Lu Shilun, son-in-law of Cao Li'yong, relied on influence and heard cases unjustly; litigants would not cease; Yan was assigned to decide and ruled for the plaintiff.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Lu Shilun, Cao Li'yong's son-in-law, used his backing to judge unfairly until litigants would not stop; Yan was assigned to decide and gave the plaintiff justice.

sentences.zh: 御史知雜韓億聞其事，奏為監察御史。

translations.literal: Censor with mixed duties Han Yi heard of this and memorialized to make him investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Mixed-duty censor Han Yi heard of it and memorialized to make Yan investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 丁父喪，哀毀，墳木連理。

translations.literal: In his father's mourning he was utterly grief-stricken; trees on the grave mound joined in one trunk.
translations.idiomatic: During his father's mourning he was broken with grief; trees on the grave mound grew into one trunk.

sentences.zh: 憂除，遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was promoted to palace attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was promoted to palace attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 天聖五年祀南郊，中外以為丁謂復還，琰上疏曰：「亂常肆逆，將而必誅，陰懷奸惡，有殺無赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiansheng, at the southern suburbs sacrifice, inside and outside the court thought Ding Wei would return; Yan submitted a memorial saying: "Those who disorder the norms and act wildly—generals must be executed; those who harbor treachery in secret—kill without pardon."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tiansheng, as the southern suburbs sacrifice approached, court and country alike feared Ding Wei might return; Yan memorialized: "Whoever disorders the norms and acts wildly—when he is a general, execute him; whoever secretly harbors treachery—kill without pardon."

sentences.zh: 丁謂因緣險佞，據竊公台。

translations.literal: Ding Wei by opportunistic craft seized the public terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Wei, riding craft and treachery, usurped the public terrace.

sentences.zh: 賄賂包苴，盈於私室；

translations.literal: Bribes filled his private rooms;
translations.idiomatic: Bribes and bundles stuffed his private rooms;

sentences.zh: 威權請謁，行彼公朝。

translations.literal: power and petitions moved through the public court.
translations.idiomatic: power and private petitions ran through the public court.

sentences.zh: 引巫師妖術，厭魅宮闈，易神寢龍岡，冀消王氣。

translations.literal: He brought in shamans and witchcraft to curse the palace, moved the imperial tomb on Longgang hoping to drain the royal qi.
translations.idiomatic: He brought in shamans and witchcraft against the palace, and shifted the imperial tomb on Longgang hoping to drain the royal qi.

sentences.zh: 今禋柴展禮，渙汗推恩，必慮謂潛輸琛貨，私結要櫂，假息遐荒，冀移善地。

translations.literal: Now at the grand suburban rite, with broad amnesty and grace, one must fear Wei would secretly send treasure and privately win over key men, borrowing respite in the far wilds hoping to move to a better place.
translations.idiomatic: Now, as the great suburban rite unfolds and grace is poured out in amnesty, we must fear Wei will secretly ship treasure, privately win over key men, and beg leave in the far wilds hoping for a softer posting.

sentences.zh: 李德裕止因朋黨，不獲生還；

translations.literal: Li Deyu was stopped only for factional ties and could not return alive;
translations.idiomatic: Li Deyu was halted only for faction and never came home alive;

sentences.zh: 盧多遜曲事王藩，卒無牽復，請不原赦。

translations.literal: Lu Duoxun curried favor with Prince Fan and in the end was not restored—please do not grant amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Duoxun toadied to Prince of Fan and was never restored—do not include them in the pardon."

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 為三司度支判官，遷侍御史。

translations.literal: He served as judge of the Revenue Section and was promoted to attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: He judged the Revenue Section and was promoted to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 歷京西、河東、河北轉運副使，三司戶部、度支、鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: He served in succession as deputy transport commissioner for the Jingxi, Hedong, and Hebei circuits and as vice commissioner of the revenue, fiscal affairs, and salt and iron bureaus of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as deputy transport commissioner on the Jingxi, Hedong, and Hebei circuits and as vice commissioner of the revenue, fiscal affairs, and salt and iron bureaus.

sentences.zh: 汴倉納糧綱，槩量不實，操舟者坐亡失所載，或杖背徒重役。

translations.literal: At the Bian granary grain transport convoys were measured untruly; boatmen were punished for lost loads, some beaten on the back or sent to heavy labor.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bian granary, grain convoys were measured falsely; boatmen were punished for short loads—some flogged or sent to heavy labor.

sentences.zh: 琰始奏選官監視，謂之「定計斗面」。

translations.literal: Yan first memorialized selecting officials to supervise, calling it the "fixed measure of the hoist face."
translations.idiomatic: Yan first memorialized appointing overseers for the measuring platform, calling the practice "fixed hoist-face reckoning."

sentences.zh: 積遷至尚書工部郎中，卒。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to director in the Ministry of Works and died.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to director in the Ministry of Works and died.

sentences.zh: 李宥，字仲嚴，唐之後裔，自吳徙青，遂為青人。

translations.literal: Li You, styled Zhongyan, was a descendant of Tang who migrated from Wu to Qing and thus became a man of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Li You, styled Zhongyan, was of Tang descent; his family moved from Wu to Qing and became Qing natives.

sentences.zh: 祖成，五代末，以詩酒遊公卿間，善摹寫山水，至得意處，疑非筆墨所成。

translations.literal: His grandfather Cheng, in the late Five Dynasties, moved among grandees with poetry and wine and was skilled at copying landscape—at moments of inspiration it seemed not made by brush and ink.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Cheng, in the late Five Dynasties, mingled with grandees through poetry and wine and excelled at landscape painting—at his best moments the work seemed beyond brush and ink.

sentences.zh: 人欲求者，先為置酒，酒酣落筆，煙景萬狀，世傳以為寶。

translations.literal: Those who wished for his work he first entertained with wine; when drunk he applied the brush and smoke and scenery took myriad forms—transmitted through the age as treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever wanted a painting was first given wine; when he was drunk the brush fell, smoke and scenery multiplied, and the world treasured the results.

sentences.zh: 父覺，見《儒林傳》。

translations.literal: His father Jue—see the "Confucian Scholars" biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jue is treated in the "Confucian Scholars" biography.

sentences.zh: 宥幼孤，不好弄，長讀書屬文，不雜交遊。

translations.literal: You was orphaned young, did not play as a child, read and wrote extensively in adulthood, and did not mingle in social rounds.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, You did not play as a boy; grown, he read and wrote and kept aloof from casual company.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，調火山軍判官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi and was appointed military legal officer of Huoshan Army.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi and became military legal officer of Huoshan Army.

sentences.zh: 入館校勘書籍，遷集賢校理，遂直院。

translations.literal: He entered the library to collate books, was moved to collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and served directly in the institute.
translations.idiomatic: He collated books in the palace library, became collator of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and served in the institute proper.

sentences.zh: 知蘄州，歲凶人散，委嬰孩而去者相屬於道。

translations.literal: As prefect of Qi Prefecture, in a famine year people scattered and abandoned infants along the roads in succession.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Qi, in a famine year people fled and left infants along the roads in unbroken lines.

sentences.zh: 宥令吏收取，計口給穀，俾營婦均養之，每旬閱視，所活甚眾。

translations.literal: You ordered clerks to collect them, ration grain by head, and have midwives nurse them evenly; he inspected every ten days and saved very many lives.
translations.idiomatic: You had clerks gather them, ration grain by mouth, and set midwives to nurse them fairly; inspecting every ten days, he saved a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 或殺人，以米十石給傭者，使就獄，曰：「我重賄吏，爾必不死。

translations.literal: Some when killing a man would give ten shi of rice to a hired agent to approach the jail, saying: "I bribe the clerks heavily—you surely will not die."
translations.idiomatic: Some killers paid ten shi of rice to a hired man to enter the jail for them, saying, "I have bribed the clerks heavily—you will surely not die."

sentences.zh: 」宥得其情，論如法。

translations.literal: You got the facts and judged according to law.
translations.idiomatic: You uncovered the truth and sentenced by law.

sentences.zh: 提點荊湖刑獄，權戶部判官，利州轉運使，判戶部勾院，知制誥，糾察在京刑獄，同判太常寺。

translations.literal: Tariff commissioner for Jinghu criminal cases, acting judge of the Revenue Section, transport commissioner for Lizhou, judged the Revenue review office, drafter of edicts, investigated capital criminal cases, and concurrent judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He served as tariff commissioner for Jinghu criminal cases, acting Revenue judge, Lizhou transport commissioner, Revenue review judge, edict drafter, capital criminal investigator, and concurrent judge of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 舊宗廟五饗，輔臣攝事，中廢且久，止差從官。

translations.literal: Formerly in the ancestral temple the five offerings were performed by chief ministers as deputies; this had long been suspended and only attendant officials were sent.
translations.idiomatic: Once the five temple offerings were deputized by chief ministers; the practice had long lapsed, and only junior officials were sent.

sentences.zh: 宥因對力言，遂復故事。

translations.literal: You spoke forcefully on this in audience and the old practice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: You argued the point forcefully in audience, and the old practice was restored.

sentences.zh: 以諫議大夫知江寧府。

translations.literal: As remonstrance grand master he governed Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: As remonstrance grand master he governed Jiangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 民有告人殺其子者，曰：「吾子去家時，巾若巾，今巾是矣。

translations.literal: A man accused another of killing his son, saying: "When my son left home his headcloth was thus—and this headcloth is it."
translations.idiomatic: A man accused another of killing his son, saying, "When my son left, his headcloth looked like this—and this is that cloth."

sentences.zh: 」民自誣服。

translations.literal: The man confessed to the crime himself.
translations.idiomatic: The accused confessed on his own.

sentences.zh: 宥疑，召問，卒伸其枉。

translations.literal: You was doubtful, summoned and questioned him, and at last righted the injustice.
translations.idiomatic: You was doubtful, summoned him, questioned him, and at last cleared the wrong.

sentences.zh: 府舍火，宥畏兵亂，闔門不救，降秘書監致仕。

translations.literal: The prefectural quarters caught fire; You, fearing riot, shut his door and did not rescue—he was demoted to supervising secretary and retired.
translations.idiomatic: When the prefectural offices burned, You—fearing disorder—shut his gate and did not fight the fire; he was demoted to supervising secretary and retired.

sentences.zh: 起分司南京，改太子賓客，判留司御史臺，卒。

translations.literal: He was recalled to serve in the Southern Capital branch, changed to prince's guest, and judged the capital Censorate—then died.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the Southern Capital branch, made prince's guest, judged the capital Censorate, and died.

sentences.zh: 宥性清介，然與物無忤，好獎拔士人。

translations.literal: You's nature was clear and upright, yet he did not clash with others and loved to encourage scholars.
translations.idiomatic: You was upright yet easy with others, and loved to lift up scholars.

sentences.zh: 外族甚貧，宥有別業，以券畀之。

translations.literal: His wife's clan was very poor; You had a separate estate and gave them the deed by certificate.
translations.idiomatic: His wife's kin were very poor; You gave them a separate estate by deed.

sentences.zh: 既死，家無餘財，官賜錢十萬。

translations.literal: After his death the family had no surplus wealth; the court granted one hundred thousand in cash.
translations.idiomatic: He left no surplus wealth; the court granted one hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 張秉，字孟節，歙州新安人。

translations.literal: Zhang Bing, styled Mojie, was a native of Xin'an in She Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bing, styled Mojie, was from Xin'an in She Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父諤，字昌言，南唐秘書丞、通判鄂州。

translations.literal: His father E, styled Changyan, was Secretariat director and vice prefect of E Prefecture under the Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: His father E, styled Changyan, was a Southern Tang Secretariat director and vice prefect of E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋師南伐，與州將許昌裔叶議歸款，太祖召見，勞賜良厚，授右贊善大夫。

translations.literal: When Song armies invaded the south, he with the prefect's officer Xu Changyi agreed to surrender; Taizu summoned him, rewarded him generously, and appointed him right supporter of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Song armies marched south, he and the prefect's officer Xu Changyi agreed to surrender; Taizu received him, lavished rewards, and made him right supporter of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 蜀平，選知閬州。

translations.literal: When Shu was pacified he was selected as prefect of Lang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After Shu was pacified he was chosen prefect of Lang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，即除西川轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the Taiping Xingguo era he was directly appointed deputy transport commissioner for Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiping Xingguo era he was directly made deputy transport commissioner for Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 先是，土人罕習舟楫，取峽江中競渡者給漕運役，覆溺常十四五。

translations.literal: Before this the locals rarely practiced boats; racing-boat men from the gorges were used for transport service and fourteen or fifteen in ten commonly drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Before this the people rarely used boats; gorge boat racers were pressed into transport duty, and fourteen or fifteen in ten were lost to drowning.

sentences.zh: 諤建議置威棹軍分隸管勾，自是無覆舟之患。

translations.literal: E proposed establishing the Weizhao Army divided under the transport office—after this there was no capsizing disaster.
translations.idiomatic: E proposed the Weizhao Army under the transport office; after that the capsizing scourge ended.

sentences.zh: 累遷荊湖、江、浙等道制置茶鹽副使，卒。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to deputy commissioner for tea and salt in the Jinghu, Jiang, and Zhe circuits, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to deputy tea-and-salt commissioner for the Jinghu, Jiang, and Zhe circuits and died.

sentences.zh: 秉舉進士，儀狀豐麗，屬詞敏速，善書翰，太宗喜之，擢置甲科。

translations.literal: Bing passed the jinshi with imposing appearance, quick in composition, skilled at calligraphy—Taizong favored him and placed him in the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Bing passed the jinshi—handsome, quick with words, skilled at calligraphy; Taizong favored him and placed him in the top grade.

sentences.zh: 解褐將作監丞、通判宣州。

translations.literal: On release from office he was works vice director and vice prefect of Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On entering service he was works vice director and vice prefect of Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遷監察御史，深為宰相趙普所器，以弟之子妻之。

translations.literal: He was promoted to investigating censor and was deeply valued by chief minister Zhao Pu, who gave him his younger brother's daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted investigating censor, he won deep regard from Zhao Pu, who gave him his younger brother's daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 會有薦其才，得知鄭州。

translations.literal: When someone recommended his talent he became prefect of Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended for talent, he became prefect of Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召還，直昭文館，遷右司諫。

translations.literal: Recalled, he served in the Hall of Illustrious Literature and was promoted to remonstrance in the right bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he served in the Hall of Illustrious Literature and was made remonstrance in the right bureau.

sentences.zh: 會以趙昌言為制置茶鹽使，秉與薛映副之。

translations.literal: When Zhao Changyan was made tea and salt commissioner, Bing and Xue Ying served as his deputies.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Changyan became tea and salt commissioner, Bing and Xue Ying served as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 入為右計司河南西道判官，俄換鹽鐵判官、度支員外郎、知制誥、判吏部銓、知審官院。

translations.literal: He entered as judge of the Henan and Western Roads accounting office, soon changed to salt and iron judge, yuanwailang in the Revenue Bureau, drafter of edicts, judged the Ministry appointments bureau, and directed the Bureau for Review of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as judge of the Henan and Western Roads accounts, soon became salt and iron judge, Revenue yuanwailang, edict drafter, appointments judge, and director of the Bureau for Review of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 唐朝故事，南省首曹罕兼掌誥，多退為行內諸曹郎。

translations.literal: Tang precedent: the chief posts of the southern secretariat rarely also drafted edicts; many stepped back to routine posts within the institution.
translations.idiomatic: Tang custom held that the southern secretariat's chief posts rarely doubled as edict drafters; many stepped back to routine inner posts.

sentences.zh: 至是，用此制，其後進改，多優遷首曹，遂隳舊制矣。

translations.literal: Now this rule was used—later promotions mostly favored the chief posts first, and so the old system was ruined.
translations.idiomatic: This rule was applied—later promotions favored the chief posts, and the old system collapsed.

sentences.zh: 遷工部郎中，依前知制誥。

translations.literal: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Works while still drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Works while still drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 真宗嗣位，進秩兵部郎中、判昭文館。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong succeeded, he was advanced to langzhong in the Ministry of War and judged the Hall of Illustrious Literature.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong succeeded, he was advanced to langzhong in the Ministry of War and judged the Hall of Illustrious Literature.

sentences.zh: 時草敘用官制，有「頃因微累，謫於遐荒」之語，上覽之曰：「若此，則是先朝失刑矣。

translations.literal: When drafting an appointment order the phrase read "recently because of a minor fault, demoted to a remote region"—the emperor on reading it said: "If so, then the previous court punished wrongly."
translations.idiomatic: Drafting an appointment, he used the phrase "recently, for a minor fault, demoted to a distant post"; the emperor read it and said, "Then the previous reign punished unjustly."

sentences.zh: 」遂除秉左諫議大夫，連知潁、襄二州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Bing was made left remonstrance grand master and in succession governed Ying and Xiang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Bing was made left remonstrance grand master and governed Ying and Xiang prefectures in succession.

sentences.zh: 徙鳳翔府，訴以母老貧窶，詔給裝錢，未行，改江陵。

translations.literal: Moved to Fengxiang Prefecture; he appealed that his mother was old and poor—an edict granted travel funds; before departing he was changed to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Moved to Fengxiang, he pleaded that his mother was old and poor; the court granted travel funds, but before he left he was reassigned to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，起復，知河南府。

translations.literal: On his mother's mourning he was recalled to office and became prefect of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled from mourning for his mother, he became prefect of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景德初，徙河陽，換澶州。

translations.literal: In the early Jingde era he was moved to Heyang, then exchanged to Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jingde he was moved to Heyang, then exchanged to Chan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 車駕將幸河上，又徙知滑州。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage would travel to the Yellow River he was again moved to prefect of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage was to travel to the Yellow River he was again made prefect of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 道出韋城，秉迎謁境上，俾預從官侍食；

translations.literal: Passing through Weicheng, Bing met and bowed at the border and was allowed among the attendant officials to share the meal;
translations.idiomatic: Passing Weicheng, Bing met the emperor at the border, was ranked among attendant officials, and shared the meal;

sentences.zh: 遣與齊州馬應昌、濮州張晟往來河上，部丁夫鑿淩，以防契丹南渡。

translations.literal: He was sent with Qi Prefecture's Ma Yingchang and Pu Prefecture's Zhang Sheng to work on the Yellow River, dredging the Ling canal to guard against Khitan crossing south.
translations.idiomatic: he was sent with Ma Yingchang of Qi and Zhang Sheng of Pu to work the Yellow River, dredging the Ling canal against a Khitan crossing south.

sentences.zh: 召歸闕，復判吏部銓，拜工部侍郎、同知審官院、通進銀臺司，糾察在京刑獄。

translations.literal: Recalled to court he again judged the Ministry appointments bureau, was made vice minister of works, concurrent director of the Bureau for Review of Appointments, commissioner of the Silver Terrace, and investigated capital criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he again judged appointments, became vice minister of works, concurrent director of the Bureau for Review of Appointments, Silver Terrace commissioner, and capital criminal investigator.

sentences.zh: 復與周起同試東封路服勤辭學、經明行修舉人。

translations.literal: Again with Zhou Qi he tested candidates for the Eastern March route service, classical learning, and conduct in the "illustrious learning and clear conduct" category.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Zhou Qi he examined candidates in route service, classical learning, and the "illustrious learning and clear conduct" category for the eastern march.

sentences.zh: 出知永興軍府，會祀汾陰，為東京留守判官，轉禮部侍郎，加樞密直學士，復知幷州。

translations.literal: Sent out as prefect of Yongxing Army; at the Fenyin sacrifice he was Eastern Capital retention judge, changed to vice minister of rites, added academician of the Palace Secretariat, and again became prefect of Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to Yongxing Army, at the Fenyin sacrifice he was Eastern Capital retention judge, made vice minister of rites, added academician of the Palace Secretariat, and again prefect of Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 將行，懇求御詩為餞，上為作五言賜之。

translations.literal: Before departure he earnestly asked for an imperial poem as farewell; the emperor composed a pentasyllabic piece and granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Before leaving he begged a parting poem; the emperor wrote a pentasyllabic piece and granted it.

sentences.zh: 徙相州。

translations.literal: He was moved to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年，復糾察在京刑獄，暴疾卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he again investigated capital criminal cases and died suddenly of acute illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again investigated capital criminal cases and died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 秉典藩府，無顯赫譽，及再至太原，臨事少斷，多與賓佐博弈。

translations.literal: Bing administered border prefectures without striking reputation; on a second tour at Taiyuan he was slow in decisions and often played games with guests.
translations.idiomatic: Bing governed border prefectures without great renown; at Taiyuan a second time he decided slowly and often gambled with guests.

sentences.zh: 雖久踐中外，然無儀檢，好諧戲，人不以宿素稱之。

translations.literal: Though long experienced inside and outside, he lacked dignity and deportment, loved jesting, and people did not regard him as a veteran of office.
translations.idiomatic: Though long in inner and outer posts, he lacked decorum, loved banter, and men did not honor him as a seasoned statesman.

sentences.zh: 好飭衣服，潔饌具，每公宴及朋友家集會，多自挈肴膳而往。

translations.literal: He liked to put his clothes in order and keep his food vessels clean; at every official banquet and gathering at friends' homes, he often carried his own dishes and went.
translations.idiomatic: He took care to dress well and keep his tableware spotless, and at official banquets or friends' gatherings he usually arrived bearing his own food.

sentences.zh: 家甚貧，常質衣以給費焉。

translations.literal: His family was very poor; he often pawned clothes to supply expenses.
translations.idiomatic: His household was destitute, and he regularly pawned garments to cover the cost.

sentences.zh: 張擇行

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaixing
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaixing — Biography

sentences.zh: 張擇行，字行先，青州益都人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaixing, courtesy name Xingxian, was a man of Yidu in Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaixing, styled Xingxian, was a native of Yidu in Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進士起家，歷北海、臨沂主簿，自宣州觀察推官為大理寺丞。

translations.literal: Entering office through the jinshi degree, he successively served as registrar of Beihai and Linyi; from investigating censor in Xu Prefecture he became vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He entered government through the jinshi examination, served as registrar of Beihai and Linyi in turn, and was promoted from investigating censor in Xu Prefecture to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 初，石亭縣掾檄將陵塞決河，眾欲登舟以濟，擇行獨以為不可，皆笑其怯。

translations.literal: Initially, the Shiting County assistant was ordered by dispatch to lead men to block a breached river at Jiangling; the crowd wished to board boats to cross, but Zhaixing alone thought it inadvisable, and all laughed at his timidity.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shiting county clerk was ordered to lead laborers to seal a breach on the Jiangling river, everyone wanted to cross by boat; Zhaixing alone objected, and the rest mocked his cowardice.

sentences.zh: 既而舟果覆，擇行坐堤上董役，埽卒不潰。

translations.literal: Before long the boats indeed capsized; Zhaixing sat on the dike supervising the work, and the sào laborers did not break.
translations.idiomatic: The boats soon capsized as he had forewarned. Zhaixing remained on the embankment directing the work, and the dike-repair crews held firm.

sentences.zh: 除監察御史、殿中侍御史，改言事御史、右司諫。

translations.literal: He was appointed supervising censor and palace attendant censor, then changed to remonstrance censor and right remonstrance official of the Censorship Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was made supervising censor and palace attendant censor, then remonstrance censor and right remonstrance officer in the Censorship Bureau.

sentences.zh: 與唐介、包拯共論張堯佐除節度、宣徽兩使不當，語甚切。

translations.literal: Together with Tang Jie and Bao Zheng he jointly argued that appointing Zhang Yaozuo as both military commissioner and commissioner of the Palace Accounts was improper; their words were very forceful.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Tang Jie and Bao Zheng in pressing the court over Zhang Yaozuo's improper double appointment as military commissioner and commissioner of the Palace Accounts, speaking with unusual sharpness.

sentences.zh: 又論河北兵多、財不足，願分兵就食內地，不報。

translations.literal: He also argued that Hebei had too many troops and insufficient funds, and wished to divide the army to obtain provisions in the interior; there was no response.
translations.idiomatic: He further urged that Hebei's army was too large for its treasury, proposing that troops be redeployed inland for provisioning, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 遷侍御史知雜事，擢天章閣待制、知諫院，累遷吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to supervising censor with concurrent miscellaneous duties, promoted to Hanlin attendant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and director of the Remonstrance Bureau, and in successive promotions reached vice director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising censor with concurrent miscellaneous duties, made Hanlin attendant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and director of the Remonstrance Bureau, and rose in due course to vice director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 御史皆言宰相陳執中嬖妾笞小婢，死外舍。

translations.literal: The censors all said the chief councilor Chen Zhizhong's favored concubine beat a maid, who died at an outlying residence.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate charged that Chief Councilor Chen Zhizhong's favorite concubine had beaten a maid to death at an outlying residence.

sentences.zh: 擇行以為主命妾笞婢，於律不當坐，御史固迫之，因中風不能語。

translations.literal: Zhaixing held that when the master ordered a concubine to beat a maid, by law he should not be punished; the censors forcibly pressed him, and he consequently suffered a stroke and could not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaixing argued that when a master ordered a concubine to punish a maid, the master bore no legal guilt; the censors pressed him relentlessly, and he suffered a stroke that left him unable to speak.

sentences.zh: 除戶部郎中、集賢殿修撰，提舉兗州仙源縣景靈宮，逾年而卒。

translations.literal: He was appointed director in the Ministry of Revenue and compiler at the Hall for Worthies, put in charge of the Jingling Palace at Xianyuan County in Yan Prefecture, and died after more than a year.
translations.idiomatic: He was made director in the Ministry of Revenue and compiler at the Hall for Worthies, placed in charge of the Jingling Palace at Xianyuan in Yan Prefecture, and died a little over a year later.

sentences.zh: 鄭向，字公明，開封陳留人。

translations.literal: Zheng Xiang, courtesy name Gongming, was a man of Chenliu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xiang, styled Gongming, was a native of Chenliu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 舉進士中甲科，為大理評事、通判蔡州，累遷尚書屯田員外郎、知濠州，徙蔡州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the top grade, was appointed Dali reviewer and military prefect of Cai Prefecture, and was promoted in succession to vice director in the Ministry of Public Works and prefect of Hao Prefecture, then transferred to Cai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the top grade, became reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and military prefect of Cai Prefecture, rose in turn to vice director in the Ministry of Public Works and prefect of Hao Prefecture, and was then transferred back to Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召試集賢院，未幾，除三司戶部判官，修起居注。

translations.literal: Summoned to an examination at the Hall for Worthies; before long, he was appointed third-rank accountant in the Ministry of Revenue and compiler of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned for examination at the Hall for Worthies and, shortly afterward, appointed third-rank accountant in the Ministry of Revenue and compiler of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 遷度支員外郎，為鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director in the Bureau of Budget and served as salt and iron commissioner aide.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director in the Bureau of Budget and appointed aide to the salt and iron commissioner.

sentences.zh: 出為兩浙轉運副使，疏潤州蒜山漕河抵於江，人以為便。

translations.literal: Sent out as deputy transport commissioner of the Two Zhes, he dredged the Suanshan canal at Run Prefecture to reach the river; people regarded it as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: As deputy transport commissioner of the Two Zhes, he dredged the Suanshan canal at Run Prefecture to link it with the river, to the great convenience of the people.

sentences.zh: 復為鹽鐵判官，擢知制誥、同勾當三班院。

translations.literal: Again made salt and iron commissioner aide, he was promoted to draft edicts and concurrently manage the Three-Battalion Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as salt and iron commissioner aide, then was promoted to draft edicts and concurrently manage the Three-Battalion Bureau.

sentences.zh: 使契丹，再遷兵部郎中、提點諸司庫務，以龍圖閣直學士知杭州，卒。

translations.literal: Sent as envoy to the Khitan; twice promoted to director in the Ministry of War and commissioner of the various government treasuries; as Hanlin academician at the Hall of Dragon Designs he governed Hang Prefecture and died.
translations.idiomatic: He served as envoy to the Khitan, was twice promoted to director in the Ministry of War and commissioner of the various government treasuries, governed Hang Prefecture as Hanlin academician at the Hall of Dragon Designs, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 五代亂亡，史冊多漏失，向著《開皇紀》三十卷，摭拾遺事，頗有補焉。

translations.literal: During the chaotic collapse of the Five Dynasties, historical records suffered many omissions and losses; Xiang composed Records of the Kaihuang in thirty juan, gathering lost matters, which was quite a supplement.
translations.idiomatic: After the turmoil and fall of the Five Dynasties, many gaps had opened in the historical record; Xiang wrote the Records of the Kaihuang in thirty juan, recovering lost episodes and usefully filling those gaps.

sentences.zh: 郭稹，字仲微，開封祥符人。

translations.literal: Guo Zhen, courtesy name Zhongwei, was a man of Xiangfu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhen, styled Zhongwei, was a native of Xiangfu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 世寓鄭州，舉進士中甲科，為河南縣主簿。

translations.literal: His family had long resided in Zheng Prefecture; he passed the jinshi in the top grade and became registrar of Henan County.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long lived in Zheng Prefecture; he passed the jinshi examination in the top grade and was appointed registrar of Henan County.

sentences.zh: 除國子監直講，議者以其資淺，罷還河南。

translations.literal: Appointed lecturer at the Directorate of Education; critics said his qualifications were shallow, so he was dismissed and returned to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed lecturer at the Directorate of Education, but critics judged his credentials too slight, and he was removed and sent back to Henan.

sentences.zh: 時孫奭、馮元判監事，因奏稹學問通博，他選莫能及，乃得留。

translations.literal: At the time Sun Shi and Feng Yuan judged directorate affairs; they memorialized that Zhen's learning was broad and no other candidate could match him, so he was allowed to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shi and Feng Yuan were then overseeing the directorate; they memorialized that Zhen's erudition surpassed every other candidate, and he was permitted to stay.

sentences.zh: 居二歲，陳堯諮知大名，辟簽書府判官事，改大理寺丞。

translations.literal: After two years, Chen Yaozi governed Daming and recruited him as signing secretary and military judge; he was changed to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, when Chen Yaozi became prefect of Daming, he recruited Zhen as signing secretary and military judge; Zhen was then promoted to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 奭等復薦為直講。

translations.literal: Sun and the others again recommended him as lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and his colleagues again recommended him for the lectureship.

sentences.zh: 奭出知兗州，又薦稹與賈昌朝赴中書試講說，而稹固辭。

translations.literal: When Sun went out to govern Yan Prefecture, he again recommended Zhen together with Jia Changchao to go to the Secretariat for a trial lecture, but Zhen firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun left to govern Yan Prefecture, he again recommended Zhen and Jia Changchao to the Secretariat for a trial lecture, but Zhen steadfastly refused.

sentences.zh: 召試學士院，為集賢校理。

translations.literal: Summoned for examination at the Academy, he was made collator at the Hall for Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned for examination at the Academy and appointed collator at the Hall for Worthies.

sentences.zh: 馮元知河陽，辟為通判，徙通判河南府。

translations.literal: When Feng Yuan governed Heyang, he recruited Zhen as military prefect; later he was transferred as military prefect of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Yuan governed Heyang, he recruited Zhen as military prefect; Zhen was later transferred to the same post in Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為三司度支、戶部判官，累遷尚書刑部員外郎，同修起居注。

translations.literal: He entered service as third-rank aide in the Bureau of Budget and Ministry of Revenue of the Three Departments, was promoted in succession to vice director in the Ministry of Justice, and concurrently compiled the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as third-rank aide in the Bureau of Budget and Ministry of Revenue, rose in turn to vice director in the Ministry of Justice, and concurrently helped compile the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 康定元年使契丹，告用兵西鄙。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding he was envoy to the Khitan, informing them of military operations on the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Kangding era he went as envoy to the Khitan and notified them that the court was waging war on the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 契丹厚禮之，與同出觀獵，延稹射。

translations.literal: The Khitan treated him with great courtesy; together they went out to watch a hunt, and the Khitan ruler invited Zhen to shoot.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan received him with great honor, took him out to watch a hunt, and invited Zhen to shoot.

sentences.zh: 稹一發中走兔，眾皆愕視，契丹主遺以所乘馬及他物甚厚。

translations.literal: Zhen with one shot struck a running hare; all were astonished; the Khitan ruler bestowed on him the horse he rode and many other gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen brought down a running hare with a single shot, to everyone's astonishment; the Khitan ruler gave him the horse he had been riding and many other lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 既還，轉兵部，知制誥，判吏部流內銓，擢龍圖閣直學士、權知開封府。

translations.literal: After returning, he transferred to the Ministry of War, drafted edicts, judged the Ministry of Personnel's roster examinations, and was promoted to Hanlin academician at the Hall of Dragon Designs and acting prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he moved to the Ministry of War, took charge of drafting edicts and judging the Ministry of Personnel's roster examinations, and was promoted to Hanlin academician at the Hall of Dragon Designs with acting authority over Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 暴感風眩卒。

translations.literal: Suddenly seized by wind-dizziness, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died suddenly of vertigo.

sentences.zh: 稹性和易，文思敏贍，尤刻意於賦，好用經語對，頗近於諧。

translations.literal: Zhen's nature was easygoing; his literary thought was quick and abundant; he especially devoted himself to fu, liked pairing with classical phrases, quite close to pleasantry.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was affable by nature, quick and prolific in composition, and especially devoted to fu; he liked to pair lines with classical allusions in a style verging on the playful.

sentences.zh: 聚古書畫，不計其貲購求之。

translations.literal: He collected ancient books and paintings, not counting the cost in seeking to purchase them.
translations.idiomatic: He amassed antique books and paintings, sparing no expense to acquire them.

sentences.zh: 婦張悍嫉，無子。

translations.literal: His wife Zhang was fierce and jealous; they had no sons.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, née Zhang, was domineering and jealous, and they had no children.

sentences.zh: 初，稹幼孤，母邊更嫁王氏，既而母亡，稹解官服喪。

translations.literal: Initially Zhen was orphaned young; his mother Bian remarried to the Wang family; later when his mother died, Zhen resigned office to observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen had lost his father in childhood; his mother, née Bian, later remarried into the Wang family. When she died, Zhen resigned his post to mourn her.

sentences.zh: 知禮院宋祁言稹服喪為過禮，詔下有司博議，用馮元等奏，聽解官申心喪，語在《禮志》。

translations.literal: Song Qi of the Ritual Academy said Zhen's mourning observance exceeded proper ritual; the decree was sent down to the relevant offices for broad deliberation; following Feng Yuan and others' memorial, he was allowed to resign and declare inner mourning—the account is in the Treatise on Ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qi of the Ritual Academy argued that Zhen's mourning went beyond proper ritual; the emperor ordered the relevant offices to debate the matter broadly, and following the memorial of Feng Yuan and others, Zhen was permitted to resign and observe inner mourning—the full account appears in the Treatise on Ritual.

sentences.zh: 論曰：肅之守邢，以贏兵卻敵，開門納避難之民，功在王府。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Su's defense of Xing with few troops repelled the enemy, opened the gates to admit refugees, and his merit lay with the imperial house.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary observes: In holding Xing with a depleted force, Su drove back the enemy and opened the gates to refugees—service that redounded to the throne's credit.

sentences.zh: 元方為幷州，有勤留之命，其宜民可知。

translations.literal: Yuanfang as prefect of Bing had orders earnestly to retain him; that he was fit for the people can be known.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanfang governed Bing Prefecture, the court repeatedly urged him to remain in office—a sign of how well he served the people.

sentences.zh: 宥在蘄，則活饑氓；

translations.literal: When You was at Qi, he saved starving commoners;
translations.idiomatic: At Qi, You kept starving commoners alive;

sentences.zh: 在江寧，則直冤獄。

translations.literal: at Jiangning, he rectified wrongful cases.
translations.idiomatic: at Jiangning, he set right wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 吏之良者歟！

translations.literal: Were they not fine officials!
translations.idiomatic: Truly they were model officials!

sentences.zh: 然皆不能無小累也。

translations.literal: Yet none could be wholly without small faults.
translations.idiomatic: Yet none of them was entirely free of minor blemishes.

sentences.zh: 日嚴、行簡臨政，視秉、擇行、向、稹雖無瑕可指，亦皆無赫赫名。

translations.literal: Riyan and Xingjian administered affairs; compared with Bing, Zhaixing, Xiang, and Zhen, though none had a flaw that could be pointed to, none had illustrious fame either.
translations.idiomatic: Riyan and Xingjian held office alongside Bing, Zhaixing, Xiang, and Zhen; though none of these men had a fault that could be named, none won towering renown either.

sentences.zh: 詢以厚呂夷簡，復致貴顯；

translations.literal: Xun, in thick friendship with Lü Yijian, again attained honor and prominence;
translations.idiomatic: Xun stood in close friendship with Lü Yijian and again rose to wealth and rank;

sentences.zh: 瑊、頻坐善丁謂，並遭斥謫，固無足議者。

translations.literal: Jian and Pin, both closely associated with Ding Wei, together suffered dismissal and banishment—for them there is truly nothing worth discussing.
translations.idiomatic: Jian and Pin, both closely tied to Ding Wei, were dismissed and banished together—men scarcely worth further comment.

sentences.zh: 琰言謂奸邪，不當用南郊恩牽復，與唐袁高論執盧杞正相類，識者韙之。

translations.literal: Yan argued that Wei was treacherous and should not be restored through the southern-suburbs amnesty; it closely resembled Tang Yuan Gao's argument against restoring Lu Qi—those with insight approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yan declared that Wei was wicked and should not be restored through the southern-suburbs amnesty—a stand much like Tang Yuan Gao's refusal to reinstate Lu Qi, which discerning men applauded.

sentences.zh: 趙賀，字餘慶，開封封邱人。

translations.literal: Zhao He, courtesy name Yuqing, was a man of Fengqiu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao He, styled Yuqing, was a native of Fengqiu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 少時，嘗喪明，久之，遇異醫輒愈。

translations.literal: In youth he once lost his sight; after a long time, encountering a remarkable physician, he was quickly cured.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he once went blind; long afterward he met an extraordinary physician and was promptly cured.

sentences.zh: 喜飲酒，至終日不亂。

translations.literal: He loved to drink wine, yet could drink all day without disorder.
translations.idiomatic: He loved wine and could drink all day without losing his composure.

sentences.zh: 事繼母至孝。

translations.literal: He served his stepmother with utmost filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: He showed the utmost filial devotion to his stepmother.

sentences.zh: 舉《毛詩》及第，補臨朐縣主簿。

translations.literal: He passed the Mao Shi examination and received appointment, and was appointed registrar of Linqu County.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examination in the Mao Shi and was appointed registrar of Linqu County.

sentences.zh: 賀有幹力，知州寇準且知賀。

translations.literal: He had administrative ability; Prefect Kou Zhun both knew and esteemed He.
translations.idiomatic: He was capable and forceful, and Prefect Kou Zhun knew and valued him.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，調丁壯塞澶州決河，眾多逸去，獨賀全所部而歸。

translations.literal: In the Chunhua era, able-bodied men were mobilized to block the breached river at Chany Prefecture; many fled, but He alone returned with his full unit intact.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua era, when able-bodied men were conscripted to seal a breach on the Chany river, many deserted, but He alone brought his entire unit back intact.

sentences.zh: 臨朐父老張樂迎賀，準使由譙門過，曰：「旌賀之能也。

translations.literal: The elders of Linqu, Zhang and Yue, welcomed He; Zhun had him pass through the Qiao Gate, saying: "This honors He's capability.
translations.idiomatic: The elders of Linqu, Zhang and Yue, came out to welcome He; Zhun had him pass through the Qiao Gate, saying, "This is to honor He's ability.

sentences.zh: 」改大理評事。

translations.literal: " He was changed to Dali reviewer.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then promoted to reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 鹽池吏欺緡錢，選賀往解州鉤校出入，賀悉得其奸。

translations.literal: Salt-pond clerks embezzled cash; He was selected to go to Jie Prefecture to audit receipts and disbursements, and He fully uncovered their fraud.
translations.idiomatic: When salt-pond clerks embezzled funds, He was sent to Jie Prefecture to audit receipts and disbursements and exposed every fraud.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，真宗決策澶淵，遣使八人省州縣，賀以太子中舍安撫京東。

translations.literal: When the Khitan invaded, Emperor Zhenzong decided on Chanyuan; he dispatched eight envoys to inspect prefectures and counties; He, as Grand Palace Steward, pacified the eastern Capital Region.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan invaded and Emperor Zhenzong resolved on Chanyuan, he sent eight envoys to inspect prefectures and counties; He, as Grand Palace Steward, was charged with pacifying the eastern Capital Region.

sentences.zh: 改殿中丞，歷通判明州、宿州。

translations.literal: He was changed to palace aide and successively served as military prefect of Ming and Su prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to palace aide and served in turn as military prefect of Ming and Su prefectures.

sentences.zh: 徙知漢州，蜀吏喜弄法，而賀精明，吏不敢欺，事更賀所，多被究詰，人目為「趙家關」，謂如關梁不可越也。

translations.literal: Transferred to govern Han Prefecture; Shu officials delighted in twisting law, but He was shrewd and officials did not dare cheat; matters that passed through He's office were often thoroughly investigated—people called it the "Zhao Family Pass," meaning like a barrier gate that could not be crossed.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Han Prefecture, he found Shu officials adept at twisting the law, but He was sharp-eyed and they dared not deceive him; cases that reached his desk were rigorously examined, and people nicknamed his office the "Zhao Family Pass," as impassable as a frontier barrier.

sentences.zh: 召權三司戶部判官，真補度支判官，出為京東轉運副使，徙京西。

translations.literal: Summoned to act as third-rank aide in the Ministry of Revenue of the Three Departments, formally appointed budget commissioner aide, sent out as deputy eastern Capital transport commissioner, transferred to western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as acting third-rank aide in the Ministry of Revenue, then formally appointed budget commissioner aide, sent out as deputy transport commissioner of the eastern Capital Region, and later transferred to the western Capital Region.

sentences.zh: 又徙益州路轉運使，尋糾察在京刑獄，累遷尚書工部郎中、提舉諸司庫務，為江淮制置發運使。

translations.literal: Again transferred as transport commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, soon investigating capital criminal cases, successively promoted to director in the Ministry of Works and commissioner of the various government treasuries, made Huai-Hai fiscal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was next transferred to transport commissioner of Yizhou Circuit, then assigned to investigate capital criminal cases, rose in turn to director in the Ministry of Works and commissioner of the various government treasuries, and was made fiscal commissioner for the Huai and Yangzi region.

sentences.zh: 發運司占隸三司軍將，分部漕船，舊皆由主吏白遣，受賕不平，或數得詣富饒郡，因以商販，貧者至不能堪其役。

translations.literal: The Fiscal Commission relied on Three Departments army officers subordinate to it who divided transport boats; formerly all were dispatched on clerks' report, accepting bribes unequally; some repeatedly got rich prefectures and thus engaged in trade—the poor could scarcely bear the labor.
translations.idiomatic: The Fiscal Commission relied on army officers attached to the Three Departments to assign grain boats; formerly the chief clerks dispatched them on their own authority, taking bribes and showing favoritism—some men repeatedly won rich prefectures and turned to private trade, while the poor could barely endure the service.

sentences.zh: 賀乃籍諸州物產厚薄，分劇易為三等，視其功過自裁定，由是吏巧不得施，歲漕米溢常數一百七十萬。

translations.literal: He then registered each prefecture's products by abundance or scarcity, divided difficult and easy into three grades, judged merit and fault and decided himself; thereby clerks' tricks could not be applied, and annual transported rice exceeded the usual figure by 1.7 million.
translations.idiomatic: He registered each prefecture's resources as abundant or scarce, ranked routes into three grades of difficulty, and assigned duties according to merit and fault at his own discretion; clerks could no longer manipulate the system, and annual grain shipments exceeded the usual quota by 1.7 million.

sentences.zh: 蘇州太湖塘岸壞，及並海支渠多湮廢，水侵民田。

translations.literal: Suzhou's Lake Tai dike broke, and coastal branch canals were largely abandoned; water invaded civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Lake Tai embankment at Suzhou collapsed, and many coastal branch canals silted up, letting floodwater overrun farmland.

sentences.zh: 詔賀與兩浙轉運使徐奭兼領其事，伐石築堤，浚積潦，自吳江東赴海。

translations.literal: Ordered He together with Zhedong transport commissioner Xu Yi jointly to oversee the matter: quarry stone and build dikes, dredge accumulated flood, from east of Wujiang toward the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered He and Xu Yi, transport commissioner of the Two Zhes, jointly to take charge: quarry stone and build dikes, dredge the backlog of floodwater, and open a channel east from Wujiang to the sea.

sentences.zh: 流民歸占者二萬六千戶，歲出苗租三十萬。

translations.literal: Returning refugees reclaiming land numbered 26,000 households; annual seed and rent yielded 300,000.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six thousand refugee households returned to reclaim land, yielding 300,000 in annual seed and rent.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部郎中，歷三司戶部、度支、鹽鐵副使，知延、同、秦三州、江陵府，累遷光祿卿，入判大理寺，以右諫議大夫知永興軍，徙鄧州，歲餘，判宗正寺，出知越州。

translations.literal: Promoted to director in the Ministry of Justice; successively served as deputy commissioner in the Ministry of Revenue, Bureau of Budget, and Salt and Iron of the Three Departments; governed Yan, Tong, and Qin prefectures and Jiangling Prefecture; promoted in succession to Chamberlain for Imperial Sacrifices; entered to judge the Court of Judicial Review; as Right Remonstrance Grandee governed Yongxing Army; transferred to Deng Prefecture; after more than a year, judged the Court of Imperial Clan; sent out to govern Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director in the Ministry of Justice, served in turn as deputy commissioner in the Ministry of Revenue, Bureau of Budget, and Salt and Iron, governed Yan, Tong, and Qin prefectures and Jiangling Prefecture, rose to Chamberlain for Imperial Sacrifices, judged the Court of Judicial Review, governed Yongxing Army as Right Remonstrance Grandee, moved to Deng Prefecture, and after a year judged the Court of Imperial Clan before taking office as prefect of Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 坐失舉，降知濠州，改廬州。

translations.literal: For failure in recommendation, demoted to prefect of Hao Prefecture, changed to Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for a faulty recommendation, he was demoted to prefect of Hao Prefecture and then transferred to Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中，復判宗正寺，知鄭、蔡、壽三州，卒。

translations.literal: Promoted to supervising censor, again judged the Court of Imperial Clan, governed Zheng, Cai, and Shou prefectures, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to supervising censor, again judged the Court of Imperial Clan, governed Zheng, Cai, and Shou prefectures in turn, and died.

sentences.zh: 在臨朐時，用轉運使李中庸薦改官。

translations.literal: When in Linqu, through transport commissioner Li Zhongyong's recommendation he changed office.
translations.idiomatic: While serving in Linqu he changed rank on the recommendation of transport commissioner Li Zhongyong.

sentences.zh: 中庸沒，無子，賀為主葬，圖其象，歲時祠於家。

translations.literal: When Zhongyong died without sons, He presided at the burial, painted his portrait, and annually sacrificed to him at home.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongyong died childless, He led the funeral, had his portrait painted, and offered sacrifices to him at home every year.

sentences.zh: 子：宗道，終集賢校理。

translations.literal: Son: Zongdao, ended as collator at the Hall for Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongdao ended his career as collator at the Hall for Worthies.

sentences.zh: 高覿，字會之，宿州蘄人。

translations.literal: Gao Di, courtesy name Huizhi, was a man of Qi in Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Di, styled Huizhi, was a native of Qi in Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進士起家，為嘉興縣主簿。

translations.literal: Entering office through the jinshi degree, he served as registrar of Jiaxing County.
translations.idiomatic: He entered government through the jinshi examination and was appointed registrar of Jiaxing County.

sentences.zh: 後以孫奭薦，改秘書省著作佐郎，累遷尚書屯田員外郎、通判泗州。

translations.literal: Later through Sun Shi's recommendation, he changed to assistant compiler in the Secretariat, and was promoted in succession to vice director in the Ministry of Public Works and military prefect of Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later, on Sun Shi's recommendation, he became assistant compiler in the Secretariat, rose in turn to vice director in the Ministry of Public Works, and served as military prefect of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔定淮南場茶法，覿陳說利害，不報。

translations.literal: Ordered to set the Huainan market tea law, Di explained advantages and harms; there was no response.
translations.idiomatic: When ordered to establish the Huainan market tea law, Di laid out its advantages and drawbacks, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 擢提點利州路刑獄，召為三司戶部判官，安撫河北。

translations.literal: Promoted to oversee Lizhou Circuit criminal cases, summoned as third-rank Revenue aide, pacified Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to oversee criminal cases in Lizhou Circuit, summoned as third-rank aide in the Ministry of Revenue, and charged with pacifying Hebei.

sentences.zh: 還，為京西轉運使。

translations.literal: On returning, he was made western Capital transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed transport commissioner of the western Capital Region.

sentences.zh: 徙益州。

translations.literal: Transferred to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 彭州廣磧、麗水二峽地出金，宦者挾富人請置場，募人夫采取之。

translations.literal: Peng Prefecture's Guangqi and Lishui two gorges produced gold; eunuchs relying on rich men requested establishing a field, recruiting laborers to extract it.
translations.idiomatic: Gold was found in the Guangqi and Lishui gorges of Peng Prefecture; eunuchs backed by wealthy men petitioned to open a mining field and conscript laborers to extract the ore.

sentences.zh: 覿曰：「聚眾山谷間，與夷獠雜處，非遠方所宜，且得不償失。

translations.literal: Di said: "Gathering crowds in mountain valleys, mingling with Yi and Liao, is not suitable for distant regions, and moreover gains will not repay losses.
translations.idiomatic: Di said, "Massing people in mountain valleys among the Yi and Liao is unsuitable for a frontier province, and the gains would not repay the cost.

sentences.zh: 」奏罷之。

translations.literal: " He memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: " He memorialized to have the project canceled.

sentences.zh: 王蒙正恃章獻太后親，多占田嘉州，詔勿收賦，覿又極論其不可。

translations.literal: Wang Mengzheng relied on Empress Zhangxian's kinship, unlawfully occupying much land in Jia Prefecture; the decree said do not collect tax; Di again strongly argued it was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mengzheng, relying on kinship with Empress Zhangxian, seized large tracts in Jia Prefecture; when an edict exempted him from tax, Di again argued forcefully that this was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 坐失察嘉州守張約受賕，貶通判杭州，徙知福州。

translations.literal: Punished for failing to detect Jia Prefecture prefect Zhang Yue accepting bribes, demoted to military prefect of Hang Prefecture, transferred to govern Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for failing to detect that Jia Prefecture prefect Zhang Yue had taken bribes, he was demoted to military prefect of Hang Prefecture and later transferred to govern Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為三司鹽鐵判官，歷陝西、河北轉運使，累遷兵部郎中，復入戶部、鹽鐵為副使，遷右諫議大夫、河東都轉運使，加集賢院學士，判尚書刑部，進給事中、知單州，卒。

translations.literal: He entered service as third-rank salt and iron commissioner aide; successively served as Shaanxi and Hebei transport commissioner; promoted in succession to director in the Ministry of War; again entered the Ministry of Revenue and Salt and Iron as deputy commissioner; promoted to Right Remonstrance Grandee and eastern Shanxi transport commissioner; added academician of the Hall for Worthies; judged the Ministry of Justice; advanced to supervising censor and governed Shan Prefecture; died.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital as third-rank salt and iron commissioner aide, served as transport commissioner in Shaanxi and Hebei, rose to director in the Ministry of War, again served as deputy commissioner in the Ministry of Revenue and Salt and Iron, became Right Remonstrance Grandee and transport commissioner of eastern Shanxi, was made academician of the Hall for Worthies and judge of the Ministry of Justice, advanced to supervising censor and prefect of Shan Prefecture, and died.

sentences.zh: 子：秉常，為梓州路轉運使。

translations.literal: Son: Bingchang, served as transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bingchang served as transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 袁抗，字立之，洪州南昌人。

translations.literal: Yuan Kang, courtesy name Lizhi, was a man of Nanchang in Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Kang, styled Lizhi, was a native of Nanchang in Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，得同學究出身，調陽朔縣主簿，薦補桂州司法參軍。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, received tong xuejiu entry rank, was appointed registrar of Yangshuo County, and was recommended to supplement as judicial aide in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination with the rank of fellow classicist, was appointed registrar of Yangshuo County, and was recommended to serve as judicial aide in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 撫水蠻寇融州，轉運使俞獻可檄抗權融州推官，督兵糧與謀軍事。

translations.literal: Fushui barbarians raided Rong Prefecture; transport commissioner Yu Xianké dispatched Kang acting Rong Prefecture investigating officer, supervising troops and grain and joining in military planning.
translations.idiomatic: When Fushui tribesmen raided Rong Prefecture, transport commissioner Yu Xianké ordered Kang to serve as acting investigating officer in Rong Prefecture, supervising troops and grain and advising on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 蠻治舟且至，抗即楊梅、石門兩隘建水柵二，據其衝，賊不得入，後因置戍不廢。

translations.literal: The barbarians were building boats about to arrive; Kang immediately at Yangmei and Shimen two passes built two water palisades, holding the crossings; the enemy could not enter; later a garrison was established and not abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: As the tribesmen were building boats and about to arrive, Kang promptly erected two water palisades at the Yangmei and Shimen passes, blocking the crossings; the raiders could not break through, and the garrison he established remained in place thereafter.

sentences.zh: 事平，特遷衡州推官，改大理寺丞，累遷國子博士、知南安軍，擢提點廣南東路刑獄。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, specially promoted to Heng Prefecture investigating officer, changed to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, successively promoted to Guozi doctor and prefect of Nan'an Army, promoted to oversee Guangnandong Circuit criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis ended he received special promotion to investigating officer in Heng Prefecture, then vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, rose in turn to erudite of the Directorate of Education and prefect of Nan'an Army, and was made overseer of criminal cases in Guangnandong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 浙東叛卒鄂鄰鈔閩、越，轉南海，與廣州兵逆戰海中。

translations.literal: Zhedong mutinous soldiers led by E Lin raided Min and Yue, turned south along the sea, and fought Guangzhou troops at sea.
translations.idiomatic: Mutinous soldiers from eastern Zhe led by E Lin raided Fujian and Zhejiang, turned south along the coast, and met Guangzhou troops in battle at sea.

sentences.zh: 值大風，有告鄰溺死者，抗獨曰：「是日風勢趣占城，鄰未必死。

translations.literal: They encountered a great wind; someone reported Lin drowned; Kang alone said: "That day the wind trend favored Champa; Lin is not necessarily dead.
translations.idiomatic: A great storm arose, and someone reported that Lin had drowned; Kang alone said, "That day the wind was driving toward Champa—Lin may not be dead.

sentences.zh: 」後果得鄰於占城。

translations.literal: " Later indeed Lin was captured at Champa.
translations.idiomatic: " Later Lin was indeed found at Champa.

sentences.zh: 還為度支三司判官，以尚書金部員外郎為梓州路轉運使，徙益州路。

translations.literal: Returned to serve as revenue Three Departments magistrate; as Ministry of Revenue Gold Bureau vice director became Zizhou Circuit transport commissioner, transferred to Yizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to serve as a revenue magistrate in the Three Departments; as Vice Director of the Bureau of Gold in the Ministry of Revenue he was made transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit, then transferred to Yizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時三司歲市上供綾錦、鹿胎萬二千匹，抗言：「蜀民困憊，願少紓其力，以備秦中他日之用。

translations.literal: At that time the Three Departments each year purchased twelve thousand bolts of tribute silk and lu-tai; Kang said: "Shu people exhausted and weary, wish slightly to ease their strength, to prepare for Qinzhong's use on a future day.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Three Departments each year purchased twelve thousand bolts of tribute silk and lu-tai for the court; Kang said, "The people of Shu are exhausted and wearied; I wish to ease their burden somewhat so as to reserve strength for Qinzhong's needs on a future day.

sentences.zh: 」是年郊祀，蠲其數之半。

translations.literal: " That year suburban sacrifice, remitted half the quota.
translations.idiomatic: " That year at the suburban sacrifice, half the quota was remitted.

sentences.zh: 黎州歲售蠻馬，詔擇不任戰者卻之。

translations.literal: Lí Prefecture each year sold barbarian horses; edict ordered selecting those unfit for battle and returning them.
translations.idiomatic: Each year Lí Prefecture sold barbarian horses; an edict ordered that those unfit for battle be rejected and sent back.

sentences.zh: 抗奏：「朝廷與蠻夷互市，非所以取利也。

translations.literal: Kang memorialized: "Court with barbarians mutual market, not the means to take profit.
translations.idiomatic: Kang memorialized, "The court trades with the barbarians not in order to profit from it.

sentences.zh: 今山前後五部落仰此為衣食，一旦失利侵侮，不知費直幾馬也。

translations.literal: Now before and behind the mountains five tribes rely on this for food and clothing; once lose benefit and raid, who knows how many horses' worth the cost.
translations.idiomatic: Now the five tribes before and behind the mountains depend on this trade for food and clothing; if they suddenly lose this benefit and turn to raiding, who knows how many horses' worth the cost will be?

sentences.zh: 臣念蜀久安，不敢奉詔。

translations.literal: Your subject considers Shu long at peace, dares not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject considers that Shu has long enjoyed peace and dares not obey the edict.

sentences.zh: 」尋如舊制。

translations.literal: " Soon as before regulations.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long the previous regulations were restored.

sentences.zh: 除江淮發運使，召為三司鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: Appointed Huaijiang transport commissioner, summoned as Three Departments Salt and Iron vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Huaijiang transport commissioner, then summoned to serve as vice commissioner for the Salt and Iron Monopoly in the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 時抗老矣，為御史所劾，罷知宣州。

translations.literal: At that time Kang was old; censors impeached him, dismissed as Xuanzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: By then Kang was old; censorial officials impeached him, and he was dismissed from his post as prefect of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷光祿少卿，分司南京。

translations.literal: Successively promoted to Court of Imperial Sacrifices vice director, served in Nanjing branch office.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in successive posts to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and served in the Nanjing branch office.

sentences.zh: 明堂覃恩，改少府監，卒。

translations.literal: Hall of Brightness universal grace, changed to Palace Ateliers director, died.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Brightness universal amnesty he was made Director of the Palace Ateliers, and died.

sentences.zh: 抗喜藏書，至萬卷，江西士大夫家鮮及也。

translations.literal: Kang loved collecting books, reaching ten thousand scrolls; Jiangxi scholar-official families rarely matched.
translations.idiomatic: Kang loved collecting books and amassed as many as ten thousand volumes—few scholar-official families in Jiangxi could match him.

sentences.zh: 抗子陟，少刻厲好學，善為詩，終殿中丞。

translations.literal: Kang's son Zhi, from youth austere and earnest in learning, skilled at poetry, ended as Court Attendance Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Kang's son Zhi was from youth austere and earnest in learning, skilled at poetry, and ended his career as Court Gentleman for Attendance.

sentences.zh: 徐起，字豫之，濮州鄄城人。

translations.literal: Xu Qi, styled Yuzhi, was a native of Juancheng in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qi, styled Yuzhi, came from Juancheng in Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，試秘書省校書郎、知隰川縣，積官尚書都官員外、知楚州。

translations.literal: Passed jinshi, served as Secretariat proofreader and Xichuan County magistrate, rose to Ministry of Punishments vice director and Chuzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, served as proofreader in the Secretariat and magistrate of Xichuan County, and rose through posts to Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments and prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 樞密直學士張宗象薦之，擢提點廣南西路刑獄。

translations.literal: Privy Council academician Zhang Zongxiang recommended him; promoted to oversee Western Guangnan Circuit criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council academician Zhang Zongxiang recommended him, and he was promoted to oversee criminal cases on the Western Guangnan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 入判三司開拆司，歷開封、三司度支判官。

translations.literal: Entered to serve as Three Departments opening-and-inspection magistrate, served as Kaifeng and Three Departments revenue magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to serve as magistrate in the Three Departments' opening-and-inspection office, then served as magistrate in Kaifeng and in the Three Departments' revenue section.

sentences.zh: 館伴契丹使，還奏：「所過州縣，使者既去，官吏將校皆出郊旅賀，燕飲久之，城邑為之空。

translations.literal: Hosted Khitan envoys; on return memorialized: "Prefectures and counties passed through, once envoys left, officials and commanders all went out to suburbs in procession to congratulate, feasted long—the towns were left empty.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as host to the Khitan envoys, on his return he memorialized, "In every prefecture and county they passed through, once the envoys had left, officials, clerks, and commanders all went out to the suburbs in procession to congratulate one another and feasted at length—the towns were left empty.

sentences.zh: 」乃下約束禁止之。

translations.literal: " Then issued regulations forbidding it.
translations.idiomatic: " Regulations were then issued forbidding this.

sentences.zh: 出為荊湖北路轉運使，部有戍卒殺人繫獄，其徒欲劫之。

translations.literal: Sent out as Jinghu North Circuit transport commissioner; within jurisdiction a garrison soldier who killed a man was imprisoned, his comrades wished to raid the jail.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as transport commissioner of Jinghu North Circuit, he found that a garrison soldier who had killed a man was imprisoned and his comrades planned to raid the jail to free him.

sentences.zh: 起聞，亟往按誅之，分其徒隸他州。

translations.literal: Qi heard, went at once to investigate and execute him, divided his comrades and assigned them to other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this Qi went at once, investigated, and executed the man, then reassigned his comrades to other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 徙江西，知徐州，就為轉運使。

translations.literal: Transferred to Jiangxi, appointed Xuzhou prefect, then made transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Jiangxi, he was appointed prefect of Xuzhou and then made transport commissioner there.

sentences.zh: 募富室得米十七萬斛，振餓殍，又移粟以贍河北、京西者，凡三百萬。

translations.literal: Enlisted wealthy households and obtained one hundred seventy thousand hu of grain to relieve the starving dead; also moved grain to support Hebei and Jingxi, totaling three million.
translations.idiomatic: He enlisted wealthy households and obtained one hundred seventy thousand hu of grain to relieve the starving dead and dying, and also moved grain to support those in Hebei and Jingxi, totaling three million.

sentences.zh: 與安撫使劉夔不相能，徙京西。

translations.literal: Did not get along with pacification commissioner Liu Kui; transferred to Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: He did not get along with the pacification commissioner Liu Kui and was transferred to Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 又徙江東，起請開長淮舊浦，以便漕運。

translations.literal: Transferred again to Jiangdong; Qi requested reopening the old Long Huai channels to facilitate grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred again to Jiangdong, Qi requested reopening the old channels of the Long Huai to facilitate grain transport.

sentences.zh: 知洪州，徙兗州。

translations.literal: Appointed Hongzhou prefect, transferred to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed prefect of Hongzhou, he was then transferred to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 有都巡檢虐所部，而部兵百餘人持兵至庭下。

translations.literal: A district inspector mistreated those under his command; more than a hundred soldiers in his unit came armed to the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: A district inspector mistreated those under his command, and more than a hundred soldiers in his unit came armed to the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 州人大恐，起不為動，以禍福開諭之，眾感泣聽命。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture were greatly alarmed; Qi did not stir, opened their minds with fortune and calamity, and the crowd wept and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture were greatly alarmed; Qi did not stir, but spoke to them of fortune and calamity until they wept and submitted.

sentences.zh: 因按致其首，奏罷都巡檢。

translations.literal: Thereupon investigated and brought the ringleader to justice, memorialized to dismiss the district inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He then investigated and brought the ringleader to justice and memorialized to dismiss the district inspector.

sentences.zh: 復為度支判官，累遷秘書監、知湖州，卒。

translations.literal: Again served as revenue magistrate, successively promoted to Secretariat director and Huzhou prefect, died.
translations.idiomatic: Again appointed revenue magistrate, he rose to Director of the Secretariat and prefect of Huzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 張旨，字仲微，懷州河內人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhi, styled Zhongwei, was a native of Heyin in Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhi, styled Zhongwei, came from Heyin in Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 父延嘉，頗讀書，不願仕，州上其行，賜號「嵩山處士」。

translations.literal: His father Yanjia read extensively but refused office; the prefecture reported his conduct and he was granted the title "Hermit of Mount Song."
translations.idiomatic: His father Yanjia read extensively but refused office; the prefecture reported his conduct, and he was granted the title "Hermit of Mount Song."

sentences.zh: 旨進保定軍司法參軍，上書轉運使鍾離瑾，願補一縣尉，捕劇賊以自效。

translations.literal: Zhi advanced to Baoding Army judicial aide; wrote the transport commissioner Zhongli Jin offering to fill a county captaincy and capture notorious bandits to prove his worth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi advanced to judicial aide in Baoding Army; he wrote the transport commissioner Zhongli Jin offering to fill a county captaincy and capture notorious bandits to prove his worth.

sentences.zh: 瑾壯其請，為奏徙安平尉，前後捕盜二百餘人。

translations.literal: Jin admired his petition, memorialized to transfer him to Anping captain; before and after captured more than two hundred robbers.
translations.idiomatic: Jin admired his petition and memorialized to transfer him to Anping as captain; before and after he captured more than two hundred robbers.

sentences.zh: 嘗與賊鬥，流矢中臂，不顧，猶手殺數十人。

translations.literal: Once fought bandits; a stray arrow struck his arm; ignoring it, he still killed several dozen men by hand.
translations.idiomatic: Once in fighting bandits a stray arrow struck his arm; ignoring it, he still killed several dozen men by hand.

sentences.zh: 擢試秘書省校書郎、知遂城縣，遷著作佐郎。

translations.literal: Promoted by special examination to Secretariat proofreader and Suicheng County magistrate, moved to assistant compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted by special examination to proofreader in the Secretariat and magistrate of Suicheng County, he was then moved to assistant compiler.

sentences.zh: 明道中，淮南饑，自詣宰相陳救禦之策。

translations.literal: In the Mingdao era Huainan suffered famine; he went on his own to the chief ministers to set forth relief plans.
