translations.idiomatic: In the Mingdao era, when Huainan suffered famine, he went on his own to the chief ministers to set forth plans for relief.

sentences.zh: 命知安豐縣，大募富民輸粟，以給餓者。

translations.literal: Ordered to serve as Anfeng County magistrate; widely enlisted rich households to contribute grain to feed the starving.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to serve as magistrate of Anfeng County, he widely enlisted rich households to contribute grain to feed the starving.

sentences.zh: 既而浚渒河三十里，疏泄支流注芍陂，為斗門，溉田數萬頃，外築堤以備水患。

translations.literal: Thereafter dredged the Bei River for thirty li, opened tributary channels to pour into Shao Marsh, built sluice gates, irrigated tens of thousands of qing of fields, and raised outer dikes against flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he dredged the Bei River for thirty li, opened tributary channels to pour into Shao Marsh, built sluice gates, irrigated tens of thousands of qing of fields, and raised outer dikes against flooding.

sentences.zh: 再遷太常博士、知尉氏縣，徙通判忻州。

translations.literal: Promoted again to Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite and Weishi County magistrate, transferred as Xinzhou vice-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted again to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and magistrate of Weishi County, he was then transferred as vice-prefect of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 元昊反，特遷尚書屯田員外郎、通判府州。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao rebelled; specially promoted to Ministry of Works State Farms vice director and Fuzhou vice-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao rebelled, he received exceptional promotion to Vice Director of the Bureau of State Farms in the Ministry of Works and vice-prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 州依山無外城，旨將築之，州將曰：「吾州據險，敵必不來。

translations.literal: The prefecture leaned against the mountains and had no outer wall; Zhi intended to build one; the military commander said: "Our prefecture holds the heights—the enemy will surely not come.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture leaned against the mountains and had no outer wall; Zhi intended to build one, but the military commander said, "Our prefecture holds the heights—the enemy will surely not come.

sentences.zh: 」旨不聽。

translations.literal: " Zhi would not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhi paid him no heed.

sentences.zh: 城垂就，寇大至，乃聯巨木補其罅，守以強弩。

translations.literal: The wall was nearly finished when raiders arrived in force; he then lashed great timbers to plug the gaps and defended with powerful crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: The wall was nearly complete when the enemy came in force; he lashed great timbers into the breaches and held them off with heavy crossbows.

sentences.zh: 中外不相聞者累日，人心震恐。

translations.literal: Inside and outside had no word of each other for many days; hearts shook with terror.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the city had no word of each other for many days, and hearts shook with terror.

sentences.zh: 庫有雜彩數千段，旨矯詔賜守城卒，卒皆東望呼萬歲，賊疑以救至也。

translations.literal: The storehouse held several thousand bolts of variegated silk; Zhi forged an edict granting them to the defenders; the soldiers all looked east shouting "Ten thousand years!"—the enemy suspected relief had arrived.
translations.idiomatic: The storehouse held several thousand bolts of variegated silk; Zhi forged an edict granting them to the defenders, who all looked east shouting "Ten thousand years!"—the enemy suspected relief had arrived.

sentences.zh: 州無井，民取河水以飲，賊斷其路。

translations.literal: The prefecture had no wells; the people drew river water to drink; the enemy cut off the route.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had no wells; the people drew river water to drink, but the enemy cut off the route.

sentences.zh: 旨夜開門，率兵擊賊小卻，以官軍壁兩旁，使民出汲。

translations.literal: Zhi opened the gates by night, led troops to strike the enemy back a little, posted government soldiers on both flanks, and let the people go out to draw water.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi opened the gates by night, led troops to strike the enemy back a little, and posted government soldiers on both flanks so the people could go out to draw water.

sentences.zh: 復以渠泥覆積草，賊望見，以為水有餘。

translations.literal: He also spread ditch mud over piled grass; when the enemy saw it from afar they believed water was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: He also spread ditch mud over heaps of grass so that, seen from afar, the enemy took the supply of water to be ample.

sentences.zh: 督居民乘城力戰，賊死傷者眾，隨解去。

translations.literal: Urged the residents to fight from the walls with all their strength; many of the enemy were killed or wounded, and they soon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He urged the residents to fight from the walls with all their strength; many of the enemy were killed or wounded, and they soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 以功遷都官員外郎，徙知萊州。

translations.literal: For merit promoted to Punishments Bureau vice director, transferred to serve as Laizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Punishments and transferred to serve as prefect of Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 葉清臣舉材堪將帥，召對，改知邢州，擢提點河東路刑獄。

translations.literal: Ye Qingchen recommended his talent as fit for command; summoned for audience; changed to Xingzhou prefect; promoted to oversee Hedong Circuit criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Qingchen recommended his talent as fit for command; summoned for audience, he was changed to prefect of Xingzhou and promoted to oversee criminal cases on the Hedong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 范仲淹、歐陽修復言其鷙武有謀略，除閤門使，固辭。

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan and Ouyang Xiu again said he was fierce in war and possessed strategy; appointed Gate Commissioner; firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan and Ouyang Xiu again said he was fierce in war and possessed strategy; he was appointed Gate Commissioner but firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 進工部郎中、知鳳翔府，加直史館、知梓州，以直龍圖閣知荊南。

translations.literal: Advanced to Ministry of Works director and Fengxiang prefect; added as Historical Archives compiler and Zizhou prefect; served as Jingnan prefect with Direct Dragon Diagram Hall compiler rank.
translations.idiomatic: Advanced to director in the Ministry of Works and prefect of Fengxiang, added as compiler in the Historical Archives and prefect of Zizhou, then served as prefect of Jingnan with the rank of Direct Compiler in the Dragon Diagram Hall.

sentences.zh: 入判尚書刑部，累遷光祿卿，知潞、晉二州。

translations.literal: Entered to serve as Ministry of Justice magistrate; successively promoted to Court of Imperial Sacrifices director; governed Lu and Jin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to serve as magistrate in the Ministry of Justice, rose to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and governed Lu and Jin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以老疾，權判西京御史臺，尋卒。

translations.literal: Due to age and illness given provisional charge of the Western Capital Censorate; soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Due to age and illness he was given provisional charge of the Western Capital Censorate and soon died.

sentences.zh: 齊廓，字公辟，越州會稽人。

translations.literal: Qi Kuo, styled Gongbi, was a native of Kuaiji in Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Kuo, styled Gongbi, came from Kuaiji in Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 舉進士第，自梧州推官累遷太常博士、知審刑詳議官，知通、泰州。

translations.literal: Passed jinshi; rising from Wuzhou investigating officer through posts to Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite and Court of Judicial Review reviewing officer; served as Tong and Taizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, rising from investigating officer in Wuzhou through posts to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and reviewing officer in the Court of Judicial Review, and served as prefect of Tong and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 提點荊湖南路刑獄。

translations.literal: Overseeing Southern Hunan Circuit criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: He oversaw criminal cases on the Southern Hunan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 潭州鞫繫囚七人為強盜，當論死。

translations.literal: At Tanzhou seven prisoners under interrogation were charged as armed robbers and condemned to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Tanzhou seven prisoners under interrogation had been charged as armed robbers and sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 廓訊得其狀非強，付州使劾正，乃悉免死。

translations.literal: Kuo examined them and found the facts did not support robbery; handed them back to the prefecture for reinvestigation, and all were spared death.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo examined them and found the facts did not support robbery; he handed them back to the prefecture for reinvestigation, and all were spared death.

sentences.zh: 平陽縣自馬氏時稅民丁錢，歲輸銀二萬八千兩，民生子，至壯不敢束髮，廓奏蠲除之。

translations.literal: Pingyang County since the Ma clan era taxed households per male child; each year twenty-eight thousand taels of silver were delivered; when common people had sons they did not dare bind their hair even when grown—Kuo memorialized to abolish the tax.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang County since the Ma clan era taxed households per male child, delivering twenty-eight thousand taels of silver each year; when common people had sons they did not dare bind their hair even when grown—Kuo memorialized to abolish the tax.

sentences.zh: 歷三司度支、開封府判官，出為江西、淮南轉運使。

translations.literal: Served as Three Departments revenue and Kaifeng prefecture magistrate; went out as Jiangxi and Huainan transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate in the Three Departments revenue section and in the Kaifeng prefecture office, then went out as transport commissioner of Jiangxi and Huainan.

sentences.zh: 時初兼按察，同時奉使者，競為苛刻邀聲名，獨廓奉法如平時，人以為長厚。

translations.literal: When circuit commissioners first took on inspection duties as well, those serving on the same missions competed in severity to win renown—Kuo alone enforced the law as in ordinary times, and people considered him steadfast and generous.
translations.idiomatic: When commissioners first combined transport with inspection, their colleagues vied in harshness to win a name—Kuo alone applied the law as before, and men judged him long-suffering and generous.

sentences.zh: 入判鹽鐵勾院，加史館、知荊南府，徙明、舒、湖三州，積官光祿卿、直秘閣，以疾分司南京，改秘書監，卒。

translations.literal: Entered to serve as Salt and Iron Accounts Office magistrate; added to Historical Archives and made Jingnan prefect; transferred through Ming, Shu, and Hu prefectures; rose to Court of Imperial Sacrifices director and Privy Archives compiler; due to illness served in Nanjing branch; then made Secretariat director; died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to serve as magistrate in the Salt and Iron Accounts Office, added to the Historical Archives and made prefect of Jingnan, transferred through Ming, Shu, and Hu prefectures, rose to Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Compiler in the Privy Archives; due to illness he served in the Nanjing branch, then was made Director of the Secretariat, and died.

sentences.zh: 廓寬柔恭謹，人犯之不校。

translations.literal: Kuo was gentle, mild, respectful, and careful; when others offended him he did not contend.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo was mild, courteous, and careful; when others wronged him he did not answer in kind.

sentences.zh: 弟唐，為吉州司理參軍，博覽強記，嘗舉賢良方正，對策入等。

translations.literal: His younger brother Tang was Jizhou judicial aide, widely read with a powerful memory; once entered the erudite and upright examination and passed his policy response at the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Tang was judicial aide in Jizhou, widely read with a powerful memory; he once entered the erudite and upright examination and passed his policy response at the top grade.

sentences.zh: 越州蔣堂奏廓及唐父母垂老，窮居鄉里，二子委而之官，唐復久不歸省，於是罷唐，令歸侍養。

translations.literal: Jiang Tang of Yuezhou memorialized that Kuo and Tang's parents were old and poor in the countryside while the two sons had left them for office, and Tang had long failed to return home—Tang was therefore dismissed and ordered to go home to serve his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Tang of Yuezhou reported that Kuo and Tang's parents were aged and destitute in the village while both sons had abandoned them for office, and Tang had long failed to visit home—Tang was dismissed and ordered to return and care for them.

sentences.zh: 廓方使湖南，雖置不問，然士論薄之。

translations.literal: Kuo was then on mission in Hunan; although nothing was done to him, scholarly opinion looked down on him.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo was then on mission in Hunan; though he was not punished, men of letters held him in contempt.

sentences.zh: 鄭驤，字士龍，河南人。

translations.literal: Zheng Xiang, styled Shilong, was a native of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xiang, styled Shilong, came from Henan.

sentences.zh: 登進士第，更慶、汝、鄭、秦州推官，改秘書省著作郎、知垣曲縣。

translations.literal: Passed jinshi; served successively as investigating officer in Qing, Ru, Zheng, and Qin prefectures; then became Secretariat compiler and Yuanqu County magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, served successively as investigating officer in Qing, Ru, Zheng, and Qin prefectures, then became compiler in the Secretariat and magistrate of Yuanqu County.

sentences.zh: 康繼英辟簽書衛州判官事，劉從德代繼英，又表驤有善狀，進一官。

translations.literal: Kang Jiying recruited him to sign documents as Weizhou vice-prefect; when Liu Congde replaced Kang Jiying he again reported Xiang's excellent record and he received one rank promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Jiying recruited him to sign documents as vice-prefect of Weizhou; when Liu Congde replaced Kang Jiying he again reported Xiang's excellent record and he received one rank promotion.

sentences.zh: 尋監左藏庫，遷太常博士、知乾州，提點益州路刑獄，為三司度支判官。

translations.literal: Soon supervising the Left Storehouse; promoted to Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite and Ganzhou prefect; overseeing Yizhou Circuit criminal cases; served as Three Departments revenue magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Soon supervising the Left Storehouse, he was promoted to erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and prefect of Ganzhou, oversaw criminal cases on Yizhou Circuit, and served as revenue magistrate in the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 建言：「蜀人引江水溉田，率有禁，歲旱利不均，宜弛其禁。

translations.literal: Offered advice: "Shu people draw river water to irrigate fields but are generally forbidden; in years of drought the benefit is uneven—it would be right to relax the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: He offered advice: "Shu people draw river water to irrigate fields but are generally forbidden to do so; in years of drought the benefit is uneven—it would be right to relax the prohibition.

sentences.zh: 」 又言：「京西旱，舊禁粟無出國門，可且勿禁。」

translations.literal: " He also said: "Jingxi is in drought; the old prohibition on grain leaving the capital gates could be temporarily lifted."
translations.idiomatic: " He also said, "Jingxi is in drought; the old prohibition on grain leaving the capital gates could be temporarily lifted."

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，與魚周詢刺陝西民兵十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the Qingli era, together with Yu Zhouxun he inspected more than one hundred thousand militia in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era he joined Yu Zhouxun in inspecting more than one hundred thousand militia in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 除陝西轉運、按察使兼三門發運使，加直史館、河北轉運使，入為度支副使。

translations.literal: Appointed Shaanxi transport and inspection commissioner and concurrent Sanmen transport commissioner; added as Historical Archives compiler and Hebei transport commissioner; entered as revenue vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed transport and inspection commissioner of Shaanxi and concurrent transport commissioner at Sanmen, added as compiler in the Historical Archives and transport commissioner of Hebei, then entered as vice commissioner for revenue.

sentences.zh: 河決德州，入王紀口，議欲徙州，詔驤往視之，還言州不當徙，已而州果無患。

translations.literal: The Yellow River breached at Dezhou and entered Wangji Pass; officials debated moving the prefecture; Xiang was ordered to inspect the site and reported the prefecture should not be moved—and indeed it suffered no harm afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River broke through at Dezhou and poured into Wangji Pass, officials debated relocating the prefectural seat; Xiang was sent to inspect the site and argued against moving it—and the prefecture indeed came to no harm.

sentences.zh: 又為河北轉運使。

translations.literal: Again served as Hebei transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 王則反，討平之。

translations.literal: Wang Ze rebelled; he was suppressed and the rebellion pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Ze rebelled, he suppressed the rebellion and pacified it.

sentences.zh: 除天章閣待制、知鳳翔府。

translations.literal: Appointed Hall of Heavenly Manifestations attendant gentleman and Fengxiang prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Attendant Gentleman in the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 先是，皇甫泌、夏安期皆為轉運使，泌先謫去，安期後至，不及賞，驤因辭不受，願命推功與二人。

translations.literal: Earlier Huangfu Bi and Xia Anqi had both been transport commissioners; Bi was demoted and left first, and Anqi arrived later and missed the reward—Xiang therefore declined to accept honors and asked that credit be extended to both men.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Bi and Xia Anqi had both served as transport commissioners before him; Bi was demoted and departed first, and Anqi arrived too late for the reward—Xiang therefore refused the honors and asked that the merit be granted to both men.

sentences.zh: 復為河北都轉運使，累遷尚書工部郎中，以疾知華州，卒。

translations.literal: Again served as chief Hebei transport commissioner; rose to Ministry of Works director; due to illness made Huazhou prefect; died.
translations.idiomatic: Again serving as chief transport commissioner of Hebei, he rose to director in the Ministry of Works; due to illness he was made prefect of Huazhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：歷觀數子，風跡雖不同，其為政愛民，謙己利物，有古道焉。

translations.literal: Commentary: Surveying these several men, though their conduct and tracks differ, in governing they loved the people, humbled themselves, and benefited things—there is an ancient Way in this.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Surveying these several men, though their conduct and tracks differ, in governing they loved the people, humbled themselves, and benefited others—there is an ancient Way in this.

sentences.zh: 若旨浚渒河，覿罷采金，抗論互市，起賑窮戢暴，驤推功與人，皆無所愧矣。

translations.literal: Zhi's dredging of the Bei River, Di's abolition of gold mining, Kang's remonstrance on border trade, Qi's relief of the destitute and suppression of violence, Xiang's passing credit to others—all leave nothing to regret.
translations.idiomatic: Whether Zhi dredging the Bei River, Di ending gold mining, Kang arguing against border trade, Qi feeding the poor and quelling violence, or Xiang yielding credit to others—none need feel ashamed.

sentences.zh: 趙賀不忘李中庸，而齊廓兄弟棄親以徇榮，用心何其不同哉！

translations.literal: Zhao He's remembrance of Li Zhongyong stands against the Qi brothers' abandonment of their parents to pursue glory—how different their hearts were!
translations.idiomatic: Zhao He never forgot Li Zhongyong, yet the Qi brothers cast aside their parents to chase rank—what a gulf lay between their hearts!
